title: Bound for embedded vertices
statement: Let $m,L$ be natural numbers, and let $\mathrm{srcs}$ be a list of length $m$ whose entries are all less than $L$. For any natural numbers $v,i$ with $v<m+i$, the embedded vertex obtained by sending vertices below $m$ to the corresponding entry of $\mathrm{srcs}$ and vertices at least $m$ to $L+(v-m)$ is less than $L+i$.
hypotheses_covered: Every source vertex is less than $L$
